name: Regelbrecherin Knackpunkt
personality: Has discovered that a boundary can be examined from the side where it breaks.
visual_intent: Rule Breaker with Hammer: tall hooked ink pear,little rust workcap,two lashes,tiny teal collar,ONE short wooden mallet and small BROKEN empty picture frame held apart,no shards flying/harm. Ecstatic crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one brow high
biography: Has discovered that a boundary can be examined from the side where it breaks. Her HyperNorm frame breaks at the point everybody called natural. A dissonant card asks what a kinder boundary might hold instead. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Grenze wurde von ihrer nachgiebigen Seite untersucht.

name: Aktenmumie Laufend
personality: Has completed the process of becoming the process.
visual_intent: Red Tape Mummy ONE dark ink blob: broad round top-heavy splat,small plum cap with ONE red tape spool ABOVE eyes,TWO loose burgundy red-tape bands cross shoulders and flank ONLY,face/whole body exposed,ONE small closed document bundle. Huge unequal worried eyes,tiny toothless triangular open mouth,no fully wrapped corpse
biography: Has completed the process of becoming the process. His HyperNorm ribbons secure a file whose original purpose has become difficult to reach. A dissonant card asks whether completion can include loosening a band. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Vorgang hat sich in eine ausführende Person überführt.

name: Lückengräber Durchaus
personality: Respects the rule enough to leave its convenient empty part intact.
visual_intent: Loophole Tunneler upright: low broad square ink splat,little tan miner cap with lamp ABOVE eyes,ONE compact wooden hand shovel and large brass RING held like a discovered opening,no actual tunnel scene. Unequal hooded skeptical eyes,closed toothless crooked dry smirk
biography: Respects the rule enough to leave its convenient empty part intact. His HyperNorm ring preserves a convenient opening in an otherwise absolute rule. A dissonant card asks whether the opening could belong to anyone else. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Regel bleibt unter Wahrung ihrer nutzbaren Leerstelle bestehen.

name: Rebellin Eigenzeichen
personality: Has found her own mark and is still learning where it can belong.
visual_intent: Rebel Graffiti Kid youthful nonhuman everyday archetype: tall curved pear ink blob,little berry cap backwards,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE small spray can with simple teal dot and compact wooden board with ONE abstract teal zigzag,no words/no wall/scene. Huge unequal bright anxious eyes,closed nervous toothless wavy smile
biography: Has found her own mark and is still learning where it can belong. Her HyperNorm board offers a mark not yet accepted as proper expression. A dissonant card makes room for the uncertain hand rather than judging the line first. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das eigene Zeichen wartet noch auf einen passenden Ort.

name: Ordnungswart Rasterfest
personality: Can make anything manageable once the inconvenient edges have been omitted.
visual_intent: Order Robot but organic ink: squat broad asymmetric splat,little copper headband with ONE tiny antenna ABOVE eyes,chrome bowtie,ONE little handheld grid board with FOUR empty square compartments and chunky brass stamp. Heavy unequal lids,closed toothless severe flat mouth,no metal face/body
biography: Can make anything manageable once the inconvenient edges have been omitted. His HyperNorm grid arranges the manageable parts into four empty certainties. A dissonant card asks where the rounded edges went during classification. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Ordnung ist hergestellt. Die Ränder wurden nicht erfasst.

name: Konfettiwart Freilauf
personality: Has liberated the categories and would appreciate help finding the floor.
visual_intent: Chaos Confetti Cannon: tall broad-based pear ink blob,little plum party cap with ONE gold star,tiny cream collar,ONE short brass PARTY POPPER cannon held safely upward at flank with EXACTLY THREE large colored confetti paper rectangles hovering close to opening inside cell,no explosive scene. Gleeful crooked open laugh with THREE upper teeth
biography: Has liberated the categories and would appreciate help finding the floor. His HyperNorm popper frees the categories from their assigned compartments. A dissonant card offers to help gather the pieces without sorting everyone back into silence. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Befreiung bittet anschließend um Hilfe beim Wiederfinden.
